editionLabel: Z-Man original English Season 2 base rulebook
firstPlayerRule: Take all the players’ pawns and randomly select one. That pawn’s player takes the first turn, then play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: Each player selects a character and matching pawn before the opening selection.
This is the starting instruction in the original rulebook. Follow any new instructions unlocked later in the legacy campaign.
